rv.q: When he enters, remarking on a day that feels somehow both foul and fair, his voice has a noble roundness and philosophical contemplativeness. His voice retains its refined grain as it rises through his range in gorgeous swells. This Macbeth is a good soul in a rotted landscape.

Its urgent rhythms, galloping pace and driving energy are well displayed in this production, directed by Karolina Sofulak and conducted by rising star Nil Venditti.

cn.t: The Met's new "Macbeth" proves a triumphant season opener, with critics praising Louisa Proske's remarkable directorial leap and Quinn Kelsey's electrifying performance, plus Verdi's dark intensity brought vividly to life through urgent rhythms and driving energy.
